data.name: Unplanned Voice Incident - Offnet Calling Issue
data.message:

If issues are still persisting for you on any of the previously noted prefixes - please reach out to us directly on 0800 12 13 14 or 0800 534 567.

If you have any questions, please contact the Lightwire team on 0800 12 13 14 or 0800 534 567.

data.name: Unplanned Incident - Hamilton Service Interruption
data.message:
**Latest update:**

As part of our follow-up actions, we have scheduled a software upgrade for the affected core router on 11 August 2026 to improve system stability and reduce the risk of this issue happening again.

Maintenance Window:

Date: Tuesday, 11 August 2026

Time: 1:00 AM – 5:00 AM NZST

A separate planned maintenance notification has been issued with details of the expected customer impact during this work.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

**History:**

---
*[2026-08-04 15:54:35 NZST]*
At approximately 3:30 PM, a Hamilton core router experienced a hardware forwarding timeout during a configuration change, causing a brief service interruption for some Waikato based connections.

Services have been restored. However, as a precaution, we have temporarily paused configuration changes while we investigate the cause and implement measures to prevent it from happening again.

We apologise for the disruption and will provide further updates if required.

data.name: Fibre breaks on East and West coast of North Island New Zealand
data.message: With fibre breaks on both East and West coast of the North Island our main and primary backup paths are down for the lower North Island, particularly Wellington. The lower North Island experiencing higher latency than normal due to traffic now needing to travel via the South Island of New Zealand first. The fibre company has not yet published ETA's for either fibre path as yet, but we are hoping the first recovering will be this morning.

updates.message: The west coast fibre path has been restored and the network is now operating with normal latency.

data.name: Outage Affecting Mobile Services
data.message:
**Latest update:**

The mobile calling incident impacting some customers was resolved as of 3:41pm yesterday.

We have been advised the issue was caused by a network fault, which has since been corrected and traffic successfully rerouted across the network.

Engineers continued monitoring services following the fix, with mobile calling performance now operating normally.

If you or your users are still experiencing issues making or receiving calls, please toggle Flight Mode on and off, or restart the mobile device. This will force the phone to reconnect to the corrected network route.

If issues continue after restarting the device, please contact our support team at [support@lightwire.co](mailto:support@lightwire.co.nz "mailto:support@lightwire.co.nz") or call 0800 12 13 14 for assistance.



Thank you for your patience and understanding while this issue was being resolved.

**History:**
